THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT, PRAYING TO ALLOW THE APPEAL MODIFY THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 04.05.2024 PASSED BY THE COURT OF II ADDL.
SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC AT BIDAR IN MVC NO. 532/2022 AND ENHANCE THE COMPENSATION AS PRAYED FOR.
 THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE P SREE SUDHA  ORAL JUDGMENT 1.

This appeal is filed by the claimants against the Judgment and award dated 04.05.2024 passed in MVC No.532/2022 by the II Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Bidar, (for short 'the tribunal') seeking enhancement of compensation.

entities.text: II Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Bidar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. One Smt. Jagadevi W/o. Maruti met with accident on 29.05.2022 and succumbed to the injuries.

Her husband, mother-in-law and son filed claim petition before the tribunal seeking compensation of Rs.25,00,000/- along with interest at the rate of 12% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
During the pendency of the claim petition, mother-in-law of the deceased died and no amount was granted to her.

The tribunal after considering the entire NC: 2025:KHC-K:7384 HC-KAR evidence on record, awarded a sum of Rs.11,48,100/- along with interest at the rate of 6%
per annum from the date of petition till realization.

Aggrieved by the said Judgment and award, the claimants preferred the present appeal and contended that the deceased Jagadevi was earning a sum of Rs.20,000/-, but it was not considered by the tribunal.
Further the amounts granted under other heads are also meager and therefore, requested for enhancement of the compensation.
3. The claimants have not filed income proof of the deceased Jagadevi.
Hence, as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, her notional income for the year 2022 is to be taken at Rs.14,750/- per month.
In the postmortem report, her age is shown as 60 years, therefore, 10% is to be added towards future prospects and 1/3rd is to be deducted towards personal expenses.

Hence,
the loss of dependency is as under:
Rs.14,750/- + 10% - 1/3rd X 12 X 9 = Rs.11,68,200/-.

sentences.text: The claimant No.1 is entitle for a sum of Rs.44,000/- towards loss of consortium and claimant No.3 is entitled for a sum of Rs.44,000/- towards parental consortium.
The claimants are entitled to Rs.33,000/- towards conventional heads.

Hence, the total compensation is as under:
Sl.
No. Heads of compensation Amount 1 Loss of dependency Rs.11,68,200/- 2 Loss of consortium Rs.88,000/- 3 Conventional heads Rs.33,000/-
Learned counsel for the Insurance company submits that, the amount awarded by the tribunal has been deposited before the tribunal.
